cek_surface.continuation.doc: Continuation envelopes — pre-authorized next Intent templates.

Continuation.doc: Attached to Result metadata (not an Op).

match_continuation.signature: (continuations: list[Continuation] | list[dict[str, Any]], event: dict[str, Any]) -> Continuation | None

mint_continuation.doc: Host-side pre-mint. The JS peer only echoes this Cap back on the event.
mint_continuation.signature: (kernel: Any, event: str, action: str, *, once: bool=True, args_from: dict[str, str] | None=None, static_args: dict[str, Any] | None=None, args: dict[str, Any] | None=None) -> Continuation

resolve_args.doc: Fill Intent args from slots. Sources: store:KEY, event:KEY, literal via static_args.
resolve_args.signature: (cont: Continuation, *, store: dict[str, Any], event: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]
